title: Yangtze River Delta AI Computing Power Has a Super Hub, with Over 100 Large Models like DeepSeek and Qwen Available!
excerpt: Recently, the Yangtze River Delta (Jiaxing) Token Operation Center was officially launched in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, offering enterprise customers a one-stop servic
content_html:
Recently, the Yangtze River Delta (Jiaxing) Token Operation Center was officially launched in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, offering enterprise customers a one-stop service for large-scale AI deployment. With the simultaneous launch of the center's official website, it marks that the AI computing power and model scheduling in the Yangtze River Delta region have entered a new standardized stage.

According to the information, the platform has built five core features: a unified API entry point, unified Token accounting, unified billing settlement, unified policy deductions, and unified security audit. After accessing the platform, enterprise customers can flexibly call more than 100 mainstream large models, including DeepSeek and Ali Qwen. In addition, the system supports automatically matching the most cost-effective model according to specific task types, ensuring a high-quality user experience while effectively reducing Token consumption.

In terms of solid computing power infrastructure, Jiaxing has already gathered four major computing centers with more than ten thousand cards: Runze, Alibaba, China Telecom, and China Mobile. These provide strong underlying support for efficient token scheduling and standardized billing settlement. It is reported that more than 20 partners have signed up to join the platform.

content_html_zh:
近日，长三角（嘉兴）通证运营中心在浙江嘉兴正式启动，为企业客户大规模部署人工智能提供一站式服务。 随着中心官网的同步上线，标志着长三角地区人工智能算力和模型调度进入了新的标准化阶段。

据了解，该平台构建了统一API入口、统一Token记账、统一计费结算、统一保单扣费、统一安全审计五大核心功能。 接入平台后，企业客户可以灵活调用DeepSeek、Ali Qwen等100多个主流大模型。 此外，系统支持根据特定任务类型自动匹配最具性价比的模型，保证优质的用户体验的同时有效降低Token消耗。

在坚实的算力基础设施方面，嘉兴已经聚集了润泽、阿里巴巴、中国电信、中国移动四大算力中心，卡数超过万张。 这些为高效的代币调度和标准化的计费结算提供了强有力的底层支持。 据悉，已有20多家合作伙伴签约加入该平台。
